subject: Skinned SDK partnership — technical & commercial readiness
messages:
From: Nina Patel <nina.patel@lumenware.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Opportunity — skinned assistant SDK for LumenWare Desktop

Hi Logan,

Quick pitch: LumenWare is launching a new desktop suite for financial analysts and we'd like to embed a skinned LLM assistant inside the product. We evaluated a few runtimes; your latency/cost profile looks promising.

Top asks from our side:
- A white-label skinned SDK (branding removed, hosted by you) or a private VPC deployment option
- SSO (SAML) + per-tenant role mappings
- Commercial model for OEMs (embed license + per-token or per-seat) and pilot pricing
- Typical timelines for a pilot (PO -> integration -> pilot)

Can you share an initial roadmap, sample MAP, and who on your side would lead technical integration?

Attaching our product one-pager for context.

Thanks,
Nina Patel
Head of Partnerships | LumenWare
Attachments: LumenWare_product_one_pager.pdf
From: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
To: Nina Patel <nina.patel@lumenware.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-05T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Opportunity — skinned assistant SDK for LumenWare Desktop

Nina — great to meet you over email and thanks for the one-pager.

High level: yes — we support both a hosted skinned SDK (remove Redwood branding, custom UI) and a private deployment model for larger enterprises. We typically run a 6–8 week pilot for integrations like this.

Proposed next steps:
1) Sign a light mutual action plan (MAP) so we can share an integration checklist and schedule. I attached our MAP template (MAP_v1.xlsx).
2) LumenWare to send SSO/SAML requirements and sample tenant list.
3) We'll assign a technical lead (Karthik) and a commercial owner (Stephanie) to scope pricing and SLA.

Quick notes on what I can share now:
- Pilot pricing: discounted reserved capacity + usage floor (we can detail in MAP)
- White-labeling: UI skinning + obfuscated service hostname are supported; full private deployment available for regulated customers
- Data controls: options for log forwarding, retention windows, and customer-managed KMS for private deployments

I looped Steph, Karthik, and Marissa for pricing, security, and co-marketing respectively. When are you available this week for a 30-min kickoff?

Cheers,
Logan Wright
Senior Partner Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachments: MAP_v1.xlsx
From: Nina Patel <nina.patel@lumenware.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
Cc: Ethan Cho <ethan.cho@lumenware.com>, LumenWare Procurement <procure@lumenware.com>
Date: 2026-09-06T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Opportunity — skinned assistant SDK for LumenWare Desktop

Thanks Logan — we can do Friday morning PT for a quick kickoff (09:30 PT).

I've attached our SSO/SAML requirements and a short list of multi-tenant requirements. A couple items to flag up front:
- We require per-tenant encryption keys if possible, and an audit log for token access
- We have a standard OEM clause that requires a notice period before any public reference to the embedded assistant

Procurement (cc'd) will want an estimated pilot price and a preliminary SOW. Can Stephanie share a ballpark before the call so procurement can prepare a PO?

Attaching: SSO_SAML_requirements.docx

-Nina
From: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-06T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Opportunity — skinned assistant SDK for LumenWare Desktop

Team — forwarding LumenWare thread and attached SSO doc. Quick asks ahead of the kickoff on Friday:
- Commercial: what pilot pricing/discounts do we offer for an OEM embed? Procurement will need a ballpark for PO.
- Security: can we support per-tenant CMK or at least customer-managed KMS for a private deployment?
- Tech: Karthik, can you prep a 15-min integration checklist (SSO, SDK hooks, UI skinning options, sample timeline)?
- Marketing: Marissa, they asked about co-marketing and a notice period for public references — can we suggest standard language and co-op assets?

I suggested a 6–8 week pilot and a reserved capacity model.

Thanks —
Logan
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-07T09:55:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Opportunity — skinned assistant SDK for LumenWare Desktop

Logan —

Pricing & commercial primer (ballpark) for procurement to use in PO:
- Pilot (8 weeks): $18k flat fee for reserved pilot capacity + capped usage overage ($0.015/token beyond threshold)
- OEM embed license (if they commit to 12 months): one-time integration fee $45k + monthly reserved capacity $8k (20% discount vs list)
- SLA uplift and private deployment carry separate fees (we'll route to Dedicated team)

We can accept standard OEM non-publicity language with a 30-day notice for marketing references. We'll provide co-marketing assets conditionally after the first successful pilot milestone.

Security note: we can support customer-managed keys in Private deployments; for hosted skinned SDK we can offer per-tenant encryption at rest using an isolated key per tenant managed by us (not CMK) — legal review needed if they insist on CMK.

Attached a simple pricing grid for procurement to reference. I'll also draft a short SOW template post-kickoff.

-Stephanie
Attachments: pricing_grid.csv

- We'll sign the MAP you attached ahead of the kickoff call.
- I've opened a DocuSign powerform for the pilot MAP and included the link here: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abcdef-123456
